findings.evidence: Every proof in the file needs `unfold counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` / `unfold counitConnectedComponentIdeal` (lines 64, 73, 82, 107, 116, 125, 159, 169) — a step no downstream module can perform. `mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Connected/LocallyConnected.lean:35`: `class LocallyConnectedSpace (α : Type*) [TopologicalSpace α] : Prop`. Grep of the file shows no `_def`-style lemma and no mirror of `eq_connectedComponentIdempotent_iff` or `connectedComponentIdempotent_eq_one`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem counitConnectedComponentIdempotent_def [LocallyConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum H)] : counitConnectedComponentIdempotent k H = PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent (augmentationPoint k H) := (rfl)` and the analogous `counitConnectedComponentIdeal_def`. Both hold by `rfl`: `LocallyConnectedSpace` and `IsNoetherianRing` are `Prop` classes, so the instance synthesized from the binder and the one from the `letI` are defeq by proof irrelevance. Alternatively drop the wrapper defs and state the specialized results directly about `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent (augmentationPoint k H)`.
findings.issue: `counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (:56) and `counitConnectedComponentIdeal` (:97) are opaque `def`s wrapping `PrimeSpectrum.connectedComponentIdempotent/Ideal (augmentationPoint k H)`, with no lemma relating them to the general terms. Their bodies are not `@[expose]`d, so downstream modules cannot `unfold` them, and every general lemma the file does not mirror is unusable at the counit point: `PrimeSpectrum.eq_connectedComponentIdempotent_iff`, `connectedComponentIdempotent_notMem`, `connectedComponentIdempotent_eq_one`, `range_comap_quotientMk_connectedComponentIdeal`.

findings.evidence: On goal `zeroLocus ↑(connectedComponentIdeal x) = connectedComponent x`, the `@[simp]` at Component.lean:112 rewrites the LHS to `zeroLocus ↑(Ideal.span {1 - connectedComponentIdempotent x})`, after which `zeroLocus_connectedComponentIdeal` (not simp) cannot fire. Same pattern at CounitConnectedComponent.lean:102 vs :112.
findings.fix: Remove `@[simp]` from both `*_eq_span` lemmas (keep them as plain defining lemmas) and add `@[simp]` to `basicOpen_connectedComponentIdempotent`, `zeroLocus_connectedComponentIdeal`, `connectedComponentIdempotent_notMem`, and the corresponding `basicOpen_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` / `zeroLocus_counitConnectedComponentIdeal`.
findings.issue: The `@[simp]` annotations are inverted. `connectedComponentIdeal_eq_span` (Component.lean:112, proved `(rfl)`) and `counitConnectedComponentIdeal_eq_span` (CounitConnectedComponent.lean:102) are definitional unfoldings marked `@[simp]`, so `simp` erases the abstraction and the files' own characteristic lemmas — `zeroLocus_connectedComponentIdeal` (:118), `connectedComponentIdeal_le_asIdeal` (:126), `zeroLocus_counitConnectedComponentIdeal`, `counitConnectedComponentIdeal_le_counit_ker` — no longer match. Meanwhile the genuine normal-form lemmas `basicOpen_connectedComponentIdempotent` (:64), `zeroLocus_connectedComponentIdeal` (:118), `connectedComponentIdempotent_notMem` (:74) and their counit counterparts carry no annotation, although each rewrites a complex term to `connectedComponent x`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Bialgebra/Basic.lean:121-122`: `@[simps!] def counitAlgHom : A →ₐ[R] R`, generating the simp lemma `counitAlgHom_apply : counitAlgHom R A x = counit x`.
findings.fix: State the RHS as `Coalgebra.counit (R := k) h`.
findings.issue: `@[simp] counitConnectedComponentCounitAlgHom_mk` has RHS `_root_.Bialgebra.counitAlgHom k H h`, which is not in simp normal form: Mathlib's `@[simps!]`-generated `Bialgebra.counitAlgHom_apply` immediately rewrites it to `Coalgebra.counit h`. This contradicts `counit_counitConnectedComponentIdempotent` (:78) in the same file, which correctly uses `Coalgebra.counit`.

summary: The counit-level layer wraps the general PrimeSpectrum API in opaque defs with no bridging `_def` lemma, so every general lemma it does not mirror is unreachable downstream (bodies are unexposed). The simp annotations are also inverted: the definitional `_eq_span` unfoldings are `@[simp]` while the actual characteristic lemmas are not.
